title: Allosteric activation of the SPRTN protease by ubiquitin maintains genome stability.
authors: Durauer, Sophie; Kang, Hyun-Seo; Wiebeler, Christian; Machida, Yuka; Schnapka, Dina S; Yaneva, Denitsa; Renz, Christian; Gotz, Maximilian J; Weickert, Pedro; Major, Abigail C; Rahmanto, Aldwin S; Gutenthaler-Tietze, Sophie M; Daumann, Lena J; Beli, Petra; Ulrich, Helle D; Sattler, Michael; Machida, Yuichi J; Schwierz, Nadine; Stingele, Julian
one_liner_zh: 该文研究泛素对SPRTN蛋白酶（降解DNA-蛋白交联）的别构激活机制，涉及蛋白-DNA互作体系，并用结构预测、MD模拟和NMR揭示界面动态，但核心是蛋白酶而非TF-DNA转录结合，方法可迁移但对象偏离。
abstract: The DNA-dependent protease SPRTN maintains genome stability by degrading toxic DNA-protein crosslinks (DPCs). To understand how SPRTN's promiscuous protease activity is confined to cleavage of crosslinked proteins, we reconstitute the repair of DPCs including their modification with SUMO and ubiquitin chains in vitro. We discover that DPC ubiquitylation strongly activates SPRTN independently of SPRTN's known ubiquitin-binding domains. Using protein structure prediction, MD simulations and NMR spectroscopy we reveal that ubiquitin binds to SPRTN's protease domain, promoting an open, active conformation. Replacing key interfacial residues prevents allosteric activation of SPRTN by ubiquitin, leading to genomic instability and cell cycle defects in cells expressing truncated SPRTN variants that cause premature aging and liver cancer in Ruijs-Aalfs syndrome patients. Collectively, our results reveal a ubiquitin-dependent regulatory mechanism that ensures SPRTN activity is deployed precisely when and where it is needed.
abstract_zh: DNA依赖性蛋白酶SPRTN通过降解有毒的DNA-蛋白质交联（DPCs）来维持基因组稳定性。为了理解SPRTN的广谱蛋白酶活性如何被限制于切割交联蛋白，我们在体外重构了DPC修复过程，包括其被SUMO和泛素链修饰的步骤。我们发现，DPC的泛素化强烈激活SPRTN，且此激活不依赖于SPRTN已知的泛素结合域。通过蛋白质结构预测、分子动力学（MD）模拟和核磁共振（NMR）波谱学，我们揭示泛素结合到SPRTN的蛋白酶结构域，促进其开放、活性的构象。替换关键界面残基会阻止泛素对SPRTN的变构激活，导致表达截短SPRTN变体的细胞出现基因组不稳定和细胞周期缺陷，而这些变体在Ruijs-Aalfs综合征患者中引发早衰和肝癌。总体而言，我们的结果揭示了一种泛素依赖性调控机制，确保SPRTN活性在需要的时间和地点被精确部署。
